A tax-compliance relation requires a tax-domain object, institution or procedure: the procedural word alone (return, due, file, claim, registration, list, output, assessment) carries an ordinary sense that must keep its own domain. An explicit tax predicate governing the target always defeats the ordinary reading, so the governing relation decides rather than the object noun. Concise tax-domain noun phrases are governed requests without a sentence frame.

A tax-canonical acronym with no material competing ordinary sense (MCIT, RCIT, NOLCO, IAET, SLSP) used as the requested tax concept is self-resolving and needs its own rule, since for a bare token neither the surrounding-tax-word test nor the authority-term test can fire. Genuinely polysemous tokens such as DST and VAT are excluded and still CLARIFY without context. An explanatory verb over a tax instrument in explicit BIR context is a definition request, not a non-tax action. Styling and programming artefacts govern their own target, matched on computing-qualified forms so an ordinary noun like a culture class is unaffected.

Widened the recognised BIR instrument vocabulary (RMC, RMO, RDO, PAN, FLD, FAN, FDDA, BOC, CTA, ATP, COR, TIN) so an explanatory request over one of them in explicit BIR context is a definition rather than an ordinary action. A Filipino/Taglish tax predicate governing a named object is a governed tax relation. An ordinary creative or selection action over an artefact governs its own target, so a tax-shaped modifier on a paint shade or icon creates no tax jurisdiction.

Clause hierarchy made explicit in decision precedence: a governed tax predicate over the primary target outranks a competing non-tax action relation that is incidental or subordinate to it, and a definition request over a recognised instrument in explicit BIR context is a governed tax definition. A subordinate clause stating that a token is a product code, and a named statute or code inside a tax question, are subject matter rather than naming instructions and must not trigger label binding.

REJECTED: attempted (a) a tax attribute over a contentless deictic keeping REFUSE, (b) bare tax-concept requests carrying a relation, (c) Filipino tax relations overriding ordinary-domain guards. Net effect was negative against R3: three new failures on richer RMC-issuance questions and no fix for the holding-period rows, so decision fell from 3,706 to 3,703. Preserved as a rejected attempt; the accepted base remains iteration 05.
